note: Set A binds most wiring-schedule values to the correct symbols (e.g., Symbol 150 3#4/0 with #4G and 2-1/2" conduit, Symbol 50 3#6/#8G, Symbol 34 6#10 with 1" conduit) and correctly captures the inverter 2.8 kW rating, NFDS 60 A DC, and revision dates. Set B leaves several cable specs attached to a generic 'cable' entity and invents connection claims (component 31 to ground, 4 to 31, PV Equipment quantity 50, connection source 20) whose quotes do not support them. Both sets wrongly attribute ground-fault protection to the main breaker (it belongs to the 2.8 kW inverter) and use garbled quotes for it. Set A's errors are fewer and less severe (misbound Symbol 32 material, a trivial 'label 20' claim, and a vague 'upper terminal value'), while Set B omits many correct symbol-level facts that A captures.
